stories.title: Befürworter wollen EU-Paket in Rekordtempo durchpauken

en.title: Supporters want to push through EU package at record speed
en.summary: Switzerland is scheduled to vote on new EU treaties in June 2027. Supporters plan to separate the electricity and food agreements from the package to accelerate the process, despite these components originally being key to gaining majority approval.

stories.title: Viele Smartphone-Apps eignen sich gut für die Vorsorge in der Säule 3a – aber nicht alle

en.title: Many smartphone apps are suitable for pillar 3a retirement savings – but not all
en.summary: Retirement savings apps are often affordable and recommended options. Lower product costs significantly improve returns over long investment periods.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Nur 180 Prozent machen die UBS wirklich sicher

en.title: COMMENTARY - Only 180 percent truly secures UBS
en.summary: Debate over UBS crisis resilience has become populist theatrics focused on catastrophic scenarios and relocation threats. An existing safety factor and comprehensive analysis are being overlooked.

stories.title: On gewinnt die internationalen Investoren für sich, vergrault aber die Schweizer Politiker

en.title: On wins over international investors but alienates Swiss politicians
en.summary: The Zurich sports brand experiences volatile fortunes as its premium strategy attracts investors, yet the Swiss cross symbol it depends on faces renewed political pressure.

stories.title: Après les polémiques, le succès très tranquille de l'équipe de Suisse en Macédoine du Nord

en.title: After controversies, Switzerland's team enjoys smooth success in North Macedonia
en.summary: Switzerland's football team defeated North Macedonia 3-0 in their Nations League opener despite missing four regular players and controversy surrounding false COVID certificates. The team topped their group in League B.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse fait le job en Macédoine du Nord notamment grâce à un excellent Zeki Amdouni

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland does the job in North Macedonia notably thanks to an excellent Zeki Amdouni
en.summary: Switzerland started their Nations League campaign with a 3-0 victory over North Macedonia in Skopje. Striker Zeki Amdouni scored twice and provided an assist in the convincing performance.

stories.title: Plusieurs milliers de personnes manifestent à Berne en faveur de l’asile et des migrants

en.title: Several thousand people demonstrate in Bern in favor of asylum and migrants
en.summary: Thousands of people protested in Bern organized by asylum and migration advocates, opposing stricter asylum legislation and opposing measures affecting non-Swiss passport holders. The demonstration targeted the federal asylum strategy for 2027 and a UDC border protection initiative.

stories.title: Après la messe géante qui a rassemblé 800'000 fidèles à Paris, le pape Léon XIV arrive à Lourdes

en.title: After the Giant Mass That Gathered 800,000 Faithful in Paris, Pope Leo XIV Arrives in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV continued his France visit in Lourdes following a large gathering in Paris where approximately 800,000 people attended a mass at Place de la Concorde.

stories.title: «Léon nous apporte de la joie»: sur les Champs-Elysées, le pape célèbre la messe devant quelque 800 000 fidèles

en.title: "Leon brings us joy": on the Champs-Elysées, the pope celebrates mass before approximately 800,000 faithful
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV celebrated mass on the Champs-Elysées in Paris, attracting hundreds of thousands of worshippers from across France and worldwide. The gathering drew larger crowds than the 2024 Olympic opening ceremony.

stories.title: Le Parti socialiste vaudois lance ses trois candidats pour le Conseil d'Etat

en.title: The Vaud Socialist Party launches its three candidates for the State Council
en.summary: Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud and Samuel Bendahan were officially nominated by the Vaud Socialist Party for the State Council elections scheduled for February and March.

stories.title: Des milliers de personnes ont manifesté à Berne pour l'asile et les migrants

en.title: Thousands of people demonstrated in Berne for asylum and migrants
en.summary: Several thousand people rallied in Berne on Saturday to protest the tightening of asylum legislation and the exclusion of non-Swiss passport holders from certain protections.

stories.title: Les socialistes vaudois investissent Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud et Samuel Bendahan pour l’élection au Conseil d’Etat

en.title: Vaud socialists nominate Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud and Samuel Bendahan for State Council election
en.summary: The Vaud Socialist Party designated three candidates by acclamation at an extraordinary congress for the upcoming State Council elections in February and March, with no other socialist nominees.

stories.title: Die Schweizer Bildungslücke schrumpft – doch aus dem falschen Grund

en.title: Switzerland's education gap shrinks – but for the wrong reasons
en.summary: According to Pisa studies, educational outcomes between privileged and disadvantaged students are converging, though this apparent progress toward equal opportunity masks underlying concerns.

stories.title: «Dieses Mal ist es anders»: Warum der Anlagechef von Lombard Odier bei KI keine Blase sieht

en.title: "This time is different": Why Lombard Odier's investment chief sees no AI bubble
en.summary: Michael Strobaek argues that major technology companies' substantial AI investments are justified, despite preferring other stocks for his portfolio.

stories.title: Der arbeitslose Swissair-Pilot von Rio 25 Jahre nach dem Grounding: «Es war eine leichte Befehlsverweigerung, was wir gemacht haben»

en.title: The unemployed Swissair pilot from Rio 25 years after the grounding: "It was a mild act of insubordination what we did"
en.summary: Daniel Riediker, a former Swissair co-pilot when the airline ceased operations in 2001, now flies for Swiss and describes how conditions differ substantially, partly because Swiss operates under German ownership.

stories.title: Ausgewanderter Schweizer Landwirt: «Ich habe alle meine Ersparnisse nach Argentinien geholt»

en.title: Swiss Farmer Who Emigrated: "I Brought All My Savings to Argentina"
en.summary: Two Swiss farmers transferred their savings to Argentina and supported President Javier Milei's reform course from early on. After two and a half years, they remain convinced of his libertarian policies.
